criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Opened the blend and confirmed the expected Mann Hall asset ID/object. The archived Purdue GIS feature is FID 635 / MANN. Independently recalculated its WGS84 ring with the documented campus projection and compared it against actual reopened z=0 mesh vertices: maximum nearest-ring error 0.000032 m. An independent OSM polygon comparison reports 96.51% IoU and 0.10 m centroid offset.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: Actual mesh bounds are X -779.712..-746.220 m, Y -518.700..-457.557 m. Geometry remains in the campus coordinate frame; GIS ring is preserved at full local scale. The independently archived OSM comparison reports 0.474° major-axis difference; OSM extent discrepancies are recorded (3.72 m Hausdorff), so confidence is strongest for the matching main footprint, with local outline detail less certain.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Reopened mesh height is 11.278 m; Purdue GIS R=37 ft converts to 11.278 m and the source roof maximum is represented. The archived architect page describes two stories plus a lower level, while GIS NUM_LEVELS is 3 and floor fields F02/F03 are ambiguously labeled. The photo supports two visible facade bands and a parapet/roof screen, but no elevation drawing was found; exact floor elevations and rooftop enclosure shape remain estimates.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: Directly inspected the archived Purdue photo and rendered isometric. The model includes a glazed two-story facade, mullions, dark wall treatment, brick accent, entrance glazing/canopy, and roof parapet. In the render the facade reads as a mostly blank opaque block with limited window bands; the source has extensive glazed corner curtain wall and a prominent curved/arched canopy. The model puts a broad brick-colored panel on the visible facade rather than matching the photo’s narrow end pier, and the roof equipment is a simplified box. These are visible source/model discrepancies.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Direct reopen in Blender 4.5.15 LTS succeeded. Expected named scene and collection contain one mesh; no modifiers or external libraries; actual mesh has 4028 vertices and 1014 faces. The evidence folder includes official Purdue GIS native/WGS84 snapshots and metadata, Purdue facilities page/photo, architect page snapshot, OSM comparison, build summary, and a preview render.

evidence.visual_inspection: Independently viewed official Purdue photograph and current isometric preview.

findings: The source-backed footprint, geospatial frame, and GIS roof maximum are strong; the official GIS floor-height field semantics conflict with the architect description.
Facade silhouette needs closer source matching: continuous corner glazing, brick end pier, and entrance canopy shape/placement are not reproduced convincingly in the submitted view.
The 37 ft maximum corresponds to GIS R, but interior floor stack, lower-level exposure, and rooftop plant enclosure dimensions lack elevation/plan confirmation.
